To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mouse NF-2 gene is widely transcribed and that the mouse NF 2 gene has at least 3 alternatively spliced transcripts.
the mouse NF type II gene has been cloned and that multiple transcripts have been identified.
the mouse neurofibroma 2 gene is expressed as multiple transcript isoforms, and that the alternative isoforms differ by a short insertion in the 3' untranslated region of the mRNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of mouse NF2 transcripts and their characterization by Northern blotting and reverse transcription-ploymerase chain reaction.
the molecular characterization of the mouse NFII gene and provides further insight into the structure, expression and evolution of this gene.
the molecular characterization of the murine NF2 gene and its products, and the identification of the alternative transcripts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the human NF2 gene is highly conserved in mouse and that the mouse NF 2 gene has at least three alternatively spliced transcripts, two of them encoding truncated proteins.
the NF2 gene encodes a family of proteins that may play a role in cell adhesion and cytoskeleton organization.
the mouse NF type 2 gene encodes three alternatively spliced transcripts, which are variantly expressed in different mouse tissue types.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the human neurofibromatoses 2 gene has been isolated and characterized.
we cloned and characterized the full length mouse merlin cDNA sequence, which shares 98% homolog with the human merlon protein, and identified 2 alternatively spliced transcript isoforms.
the mouse NF 2 gene encodes three isoforms of the merlin protein.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a high degree of conservation of the mouse NF-2 gene during evolution.
we have isolated and characterized the mouse NF2 cDNA and its alternative splice variants.
we identified a novel isoform of the NF2 transcript that is widely expressed in mouse tissues.
